headline: Updates — Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Report of auditors on financial statements for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 withUDIN'.
summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹49,244 Cr (+10.7% YoY, +2.1% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹11,689 Cr (+10.9% YoY, margin 23.7%); PAT ₹7,838 Cr (+6.3% YoY, +0.8% QoQ).
raw_text: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Report of auditors on financial statements for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 withUDIN'.

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Audited Financial Results under Ind AS (PDF p. 18 via vision, reported in ₹ crore).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from Operations = ₹49,244 Cr (excludes Other Income of ₹969 Cr).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹49,244 Cr − Total Expenses ₹39,029 Cr = ₹10,215 Cr) + Finance Costs (₹115 Cr) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹1,359 Cr) = ₹11,689 Cr (23.74% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Tax (before & after exceptional items; exceptional items = ₹0) = ₹11,063 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period = ₹7,838 Cr (Profit attributable to owners of the company = ₹7,823 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹15 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 18 via vision) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii
